lines.text: The shop is under a truck.

segments.summary: Rooftop wide at working height: two techs at an open package unit under a big sky, Twistor wordmark nav on top, the twisted-T floating center. Poster frame = this segment's first frame.
The drill goes in: the path stroke draws across the unit and the guide rides its tip while the kinetic headline builds the missed-call story. Travel segments sample at 12 fps per REA 3.1.
01 Trades AI Front Office. The gauges read right because the call was answered: ProgressCard counts the money story (missed call, booked job, paid invoice), hotspots on the three proof points.

The road between services: hands tape the line set while the stroke carries the guide onward and the ticker names the product line. The divider panel of the reference folds into this travel, per the teardown.
02 Dispatch OS. The human on the headset is the product working: one board runs the phones and the schedule.
03 Managed Data + Analytics. The guide drifts past the panel the way the SLICK capsule drifts its dwell: the systems underneath, wired clean, reported in plain English.
